title: Locks, contention and deadlocks
brief: Design lock scope and ordering so waiting protects the intended decision.
outcomes: Choose a lockable authority with a sound isolation and snapshot protocol
Diagnose and bound contention and deadlocks
entry: Transaction snapshots and the class capacity rule.

title: Retries when a commit reply is missing
brief: Recover a purchase safely when the client cannot tell whether it committed.
outcomes: Distinguish known aborts from an unknown commit outcome
Reuse one request identity and reject conflicting payloads
entry: Transactions, unique keys and application connection ownership.

title: Outboxes and database-backed jobs
brief: Commit a durable intention, then deliver and claim work despite duplicate execution and worker loss.
outcomes: Explain what an outbox makes atomic
Design deduplication, leases and fencing for recoverable workers
entry: Transactions, uncertain outcomes and lock/claim reasoning from RL91 before recoverable worker protocols.
